dataset.title: The EuRoC micro aerial vehicle datasets

notes: MH_02_easy is prospectively frozen for one position-only comparison of the existing v2 checkpoint and the single controlled v5 magnitude-loss checkpoint.
The v5 architecture, split, seed, optimizer, schedule, objective, validation guardrails, and stop rule were fixed before MH_02_easy extraction or prediction inspection.
The Leica stream supplies 3D position, not reference orientation; rotation, direction, full-pose ATE, and deployment claims remain out of scope.
After this comparison MH_02_easy is consumed and must not be reused for another model-selection decision.
